input.value:
timeseries {
    total = sum(dt.service.request.count),
    failures = sum(dt.service.request.failure_count, default: 0)
  },
  by: {dt.smartscape.service},
  interval: 1m
| fieldsAdd service_name = getNodeName(dt.smartscape.service)
| filter service_name == "frontend"
| fieldsAdd failure_rate = if(total[] > 0, 100 * failures[] / total[], else: 0)
| fieldsRemove total, failures

properties.value:
❗**Alert description:**
An anomaly was detected on {metricname}. Within the sliding window, {violating_samples} violation samples were detected that were {alert_condition} the threshold of {threshold}.
Frontend failure rate is above 5 percent
